displayName: OCI-AI-MDL-002: AI — Backdoor Trigger Detection in LLM Output
description:
Detects potential backdoor triggers in LLM output patterns that indicate compromised models

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — backdoor trigger detection in llm output

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_mdl_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%backdoor%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%trigger%') AND "value" > 0
